description: Save information to long-term memory. The content will be embedded locally and indexed for semantic search. Use this to store facts, decisions, preferences, or any context worth remembering across sessions.

content.description: The text content to store in memory

importance.description: Importance level 1-10 (default: 5). Higher = more resistant to decay

memory_type.description: Memory category (default: general). Affects decay rate

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata to attach to this memory (e.g. { "topic": "auth", "project": "api" })

name: save_memory
